observations: Photo 0 shows a bare car engine assembly removed from a vehicle, sitting on a dark floor/mat.
Visible turbocharger, intake manifold, injector wiring harness, oil filler cap, and various hoses/clips.
No engine code, serial plate, VIN sticker, or brand badge is legible anywhere in the frame.
A watermark reading 'CAMON 40' and camera EXIF text (lens, aperture, shutter, ISO) appear at the bottom - this is just a phone/app watermark, not an engine identifier.
No fluids, smoke, bench test, or running state can be judged from a static photo.
No visible damage, cracks, or leaks are obviously shown, but the image is partially dark/cluttered.

claims.evidence: No import documentation, auction sheet, or Japan-export sticker is visible in photo 0.
No written warranty card, receipt, or seller shop signage shown in photo 0.

risks.risk: Engine model/code unknown, which drives price heavily (e.g., 1KD vs 2KD vs other code).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code stamp/plate (usually on the block near the bellhousing or on a sticker on the cam cover).
risks.if_unproven: Cannot be priced at all without this; price data depends on exact model.

risks.risk: Working condition (compression, smoke, oil leaks, running state) cannot be seen in a static photo.
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine running/idling with audio, plus exhaust smoke check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working (worst case: non-running).

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history unverifiable, affects wear and remaining life.
risks.proof: Photo of original Japan auction sheet or odometer/mileage sticker if available.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged ancillary parts (turbo, injectors, sensors) not all visible/assessable.
risks.proof: Multiple angle photos (front, rear, underside) showing full engine and all ancillaries.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/worst-case missing parts until shown otherwise.

risks.risk: '2 months guarantee' terms (what it covers, who honors it) unverifiable.
risks.proof: Photo of written guarantee/receipt with seller's shop name and contact.
risks.if_unproven: Treat as no guarantee for pricing purposes.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/serial plate or stamp.
Video of the engine running (cold start, idle, rev) with audible sound.
Additional photos from front, rear, and underside showing full engine and wiring.
Photo of Japan export/auction sheet if claiming 'Direct Japan'.
Photo/scan of the written warranty document.
response.reason: The photo shows only a generic engine with no legible model/code, and engine prices vary drastically by type, so even a worst-case price cannot be set until the engine code is shown.
